{{Quote|Our Adarian-style donuts are made fresh daily by a genuine Crisp-E-O donut droid.|Part of the donut's description on the menu Dex's|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Iced donuts with shredded Ishi Tib-cracked coconuts''' were one of several types of [[Doughnut/Legends|donut]] which were served in the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The donuts, which contained shredded [[Ishi Tib-cracked coconut]], were made fresh every morning in the internal [[Oil/Legends|oil]] frier of a [[Crisp-E-O donut droid]] owned by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], who also owned the diner and considered the donuts delicious. The [[Dexter Jettster's Crisp-E-O donut droid|droid]] stored the recipe for the donuts on a database of over 2400 donut recipes, and made them in an [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] style. The donuts cost 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]],<ref name="DaD" /> and were available at Dex's at some point prior to its destruction during the first two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign.<ref name="DexEra">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]'' established that [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' later stated that the novel took place around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the Empire was formed in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], so Dex's Diner was destroyed either during 19 BBY or 18 BBY.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Iced donuts with with shredded Ishi Tib-cracked coconut were first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]].
